events.name: Rocky horror picture drag show
events.description:
Get your rice, your cards, your toast ready — Azúcar is turning the Main Floor into Frank-N-Furter's castle for one wild night. Cherry Pop hosts a full shadow cast drag production of The Rocky Horror Picture Show, lip-syncing, strutting, and sweating through every frame while the film plays behind them. This isn't a screening — it's a ritual, and you're in the cast.

The night opens right: before the film even rolls, each member of the cast steps up for their own solo number — a taste of the glitter and grit before the full chaos begins. Then it's lights down, projector up, and the shadow cast locks in beat for beat with the movie, prop bags on every table so you throw down at exactly the right moment. You'll know when.

Sing, shout the callbacks, dance the Time Warp in the aisles. The drag is sharp, the shadow cast is tighter, and the whole room turns into one glittering, corseted fever dream from the first frame to the last — interactive, unhinged, and exactly as messy as Rocky Horror should be.

Come in fishnets, come in a suit, come as Magenta, come as yourself — just come ready to lose your inhibitions with the rest of us. Specialty cocktails, a packed Main Floor, and Cherry Pop keeping the chaos gorgeous all night long. Antici...pation starts at 8pm on October 29. Don't be a virgin about it.

🗓️ Jueves 29 de octubre — Show 8:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 18+ · Cover $15

🎟️ Tickets: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/rocky-horror-picture-drag-show-tickets-2001091594828

events.name: American horror story watch party
events.description:
Curtains close on our watch-party season the only way they should — loud, bloody, and unforgettable. Azúcar's Lounge transforms into a blacked-out screening den for American Horror Story Season 13, Episode 1, projected big and loud while the bar pours something stiff enough to survive it.

Ale hosts. Ale commands. Expect commentary that cuts sharper than the show itself, a crowd that gasps and cackles in unison, and a room thick with candlelight, shadows, and good company. This isn't a quiet Netflix night — it's communal horror, Latinx-flavored, with specials that bite back.

The second the credits roll, the real chaos begins. Ale rips off the host mic and slides into a mini drag show that turns scream into cheer. Wigs fly. Heels stomp. The season ends with glitter, not just gore.

Show up early — Lounge seats vanish fast, and nobody wants to miss episode one of the finale night everyone's buzzing about.

events.name: Link up
events.description:
Grab a seat, grab some beads — Link Up is Azúcar's craft night with heart. On November 1st starting at 6pm, the Main Floor trades its usual buzz for worktables full of charms, clasps, keychains, and carabiners, and everybody's invited to build something that's a little bit cute and a lot bit meaningful.

Jayme's hosting, and this one's co-presented with PFLAG because community doesn't just happen — you make it, link by link, charm by charm. Bring a small non-perishable snack to toss on the shared table, because the best crafting sessions run on chisme and chips. No experience needed, no pressure to make something perfect. Sit next to someone new, swap beads, swap stories.

This isn't about leaving with a perfect bracelet — though you will. It's about the hour you spent making it next to people who get it. Low lights, good music, hands busy, hearts a little fuller. Come solo, come with your crew, leave with a keychain and maybe a new friend or two.

events.name: Lesbians Playing Uno
events.description:
Grab a drink, pull up a chair, and get ready to throw down a Draw Four with love. Lesbians Playing Uno takes over the Lounge on November 8th for a night that's equal parts game night and mixer — Jayme's running the show, the energy is loose, and the only goal is to laugh loud and meet someone new before the deck runs out.

Tables shuffle, strangers become teammates, drinks keep the trash talk flowing, and every round brings a fresh crew to flirt, bluff, and bond with. It's playful, it's a little competitive, and it's built for everybody who wants connection without the pressure of a dance floor.

Winners don't walk away empty-handed — small merch prizes drop throughout the night for whoever keeps surviving the Wild Draw Fours. Come for the cards, stay for the company, leave with new numbers in your phone and maybe a grudge against whoever hit you with Skip twice in one game.

events.name: Bachata class & social dance
events.description:
The neon's on, the floor's cleared, and Sholeh with Bachata Connection is ready to show you the way — paso a paso, no stress, no judgment. This is Bachata for the curious, the shy, the "I-have-two-left-feet" crowd, and the already-obsessed alike. Come alone, come con tu pareja, come as a bona fide Bachata All-Star — todos caben en esta pista.

Class kicks off at 8pm on the Main Floor under that glowing neon wash, breaking down the sensual sway and footwork that make Bachata Bachata — close enough to feel the rhythm, easy enough that nobody's left behind. Sholeh keeps it light, fun, and encouraging, so whether you're counting steps under your breath or already dipping your partner, you're exactly where you're supposed to be.

Then the real magic happens: class melts into social dancing, the lights stay low, the music stays hot, and the floor fills with bodies moving to that unmistakable Bachata pulse. No pressure, no perfect technique required — just vibe, sway, and the kind of connection that only happens on a dance floor.

Bring your energy, leave your nerves at the door. Azúcar's got the room, the ritmo, and the space — the rest is up to you.

events.description:
¿Roja, amarilla o verde? ¿Cuál te vas a poner? 🚦

Vida Amore y sus Divas regresan a Azúcar el sábado 21 de noviembre con la Fiesta Semáforo. En la puerta eliges tu pulsera: ROJA si estás ocupade, AMARILLA si es complicado, VERDE si estás libre. El resto de la noche, el color habla por ti.

En el escenario: Vida Amore, Alyana Amore y las divas de VADS con números en vivo, lip-syncs con actitud y ese descaro que solo el drag show más longevo de Washington sabe servir. DJ ShaReal mantiene la pista prendida antes, entre y después del show. Show, baile y tragos — esa es toda la fórmula.

Puertas 8:30pm, show 9:30pm. Cover $20, solo mayores de 21. Mesas y reservaciones por Instagram: @vidaamore, @alyanaamore, @vidaamoredivasshow.
